user.title: Tinxy Local Setup
user.description: Choose how you want to configure your Tinxy devices. All device control operates 100% locally on your home network.

menu_option_descriptions.cloud: Automatically find your devices and fetch local encryption keys using your Tinxy API token. The token is used only once during setup and is never stored.
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Set up directly using your device's local IP address and private key (100% offline, no cloud account needed).

cloud.title: Tinxy Cloud Login
cloud.description: Enter your Tinxy API token to find your devices and get their local keys. Your token is used once in memory to discover devices and is **never saved** in Home Assistant.\n\n⚠️ **Security Notice**: Never share your API token. It does not expire and cannot be revoked; if leaked, you must create a new Tinxy account.

data_description.api_key: Found in the Tinxy mobile app: tap the hamburger menu (☰) in the top-right corner -> API Token.

select_cloud_device.title: Configure Tinxy Device
select_cloud_device.description: Select your Tinxy device and verify its local network IP address.

data_description.device_id: Select the Tinxy switch, fan, or lock to configure.
data_description.host: Local IP address of the switch on your Wi-Fi network (automatically detected).

manual.title: Manual Offline Setup
manual.description: Select the device type to configure manually using its local IP address and private encryption key.

manual_switch.title: Smart Switch Setup
manual_switch.description: Configure your Tinxy multi-node smart switch using its local network IP address and private device key.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this switch (e.g., Living Room Switch).
data_description.host: Local static or DHCP reserved IP address on your Wi-Fi network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption key assigned to the device (mqttPassword).
data_description.relay_count: Number of relay channels on this switch module (1 to 8).

manual_fan.title: Fan Controller Setup
manual_fan.description: Configure your Tinxy fan controller using its local network IP address and private device key.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this fan (e.g., Bedroom Ceiling Fan).
data_description.host: Local static or DHCP reserved IP address on your Wi-Fi network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption key assigned to the device (mqttPassword).

manual_lock.title: Door Lock Setup
manual_lock.description: Configure your Tinxy pulse-relay lock using its local network IP address and private device key.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this lock (e.g., Front Gate Lock).
data_description.host: Local static or DHCP reserved IP address on your Wi-Fi network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption key assigned to the device (mqttPassword).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Tinxy Device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found Tinxy device at **{host}** (Chip ID: `{chip_id}`). Choose how you want to configure this device:

zeroconf_cloud.title: Cloud-Assisted Zeroconf Setup
zeroconf_cloud.description: Enter your Tinxy Cloud API Token to automatically retrieve the Device Key and configuration for device `{chip_id}` at **{host}**.

data_description.api_key: Your personal API token generated from the Tinxy Android/iOS app or web portal.

zeroconf_manual.title: Manual Offline Zeroconf Setup
zeroconf_manual.description: Enter the Device Key and configuration for device `{chip_id}` at **{host}**.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this device.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption key assigned to the device (mqttPassword).
data_description.relay_count: Number of relay channels on this switch module (1 to 8).

data_description.host: The IPv4 address of the Tinxy device on your home network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption key assigned to the device.

error.cannot_connect_local: Could not connect to device on local network. Ensure IP is correct and device is powered on.
error.no_devices: No devices found on this Tinxy account.
error.device_not_found: Discovered device was not found in your Tinxy cloud account.

init.title: Tinxy Local Options
init.description: Configure device connection settings and polling frequency for **{name}**.

data_description.host: IP address of the Tinxy device on your local network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption password assigned to the device.
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for a local HTTP response (default: 5s).
data_description.polling_interval: Seconds between state updates from the device (default: 5s).
